discussion_resolutions.finding: A smaller token footprint can merely be a shorter failure when cold correctness is unchanged or unresolved tasks remain.
discussion_resolutions.resolution: Correctness and unresolved-task counts are co-primary gates. No fixed token penalty is assigned to failure, and a token delta cannot be classified as supportive when the Ainglish arm fails the preregistered eventual-success floor or non-inferiority margin. First-pass success remains visible even when eventual success passes.

discussion_resolutions.finding: A pooled total-token-to-accept statistic can hide nonlinear repair tails, systemic instability, or a validator that falsely accepts a wrong completion.
discussion_resolutions.resolution: Convergence cost and stability remain separate. A filing preregisters the semantic outcome authority and complexity strata, reports false accepts and validator disagreements where an independent key or adjudicator exists, and reports the repair-turn and repair-token distribution within each stratum. No pooled mean or successful-task subset can rescue a failing false-accept, unresolved, or complexity-tail gate. Total tokens through a genuinely correct outcome remains a cost measure, never a substitute for those stability receipts.

discussion_resolutions.finding: Traffic weights currently map observed construct uses to representative reviewed pairs rather than observed sentence counterfactuals.
discussion_resolutions.resolution: Traffic weighting remains a separately labelled projection and cannot replace the equal-pair primary metric unless the filing supplies paired observed sentences and a frozen counterfactual policy.

discussion_resolutions.finding: Requiring new exposure metadata retroactively could invalidate existing comprehension rows without changing any observation.
discussion_resolutions.resolution: Exposure receipt is mandatory for interaction_cost_delta, optional common metadata elsewhere, and unknown is accepted as an explicit state. Existing rows and verdicts are untouched.

proposal.title: Interaction-cost receipts: count every turn to a correct outcome and declare exposure
proposal.english_mapping: Add a paired interaction-cost metric that counts the complete input and output token stream through the first semantically correct completion, including definitions, retries and repairs. Every condition declares its tokenizer, weight-exposure state, stopping rule, semantic outcome authority and predeclared complexity strata. First-pass correctness, eventual correctness, false accepts or validator disagreements where observable, unresolved tasks, turns, and repair-token distributions travel together. Failure has no invented token penalty, and a pooled mean cannot hide a failing correctness or complexity-tail gate. Deliberately target-trained conditions remain product research rather than independent ratification principals.
proposal.rationale: token_delta prices one fixed surface under named tokenizers but cannot show whether a reader needs a glossary, makes a wrong attempt, or consumes repair turns. Conversely, a comprehension percentage can hide a much larger prompt and retry budget. A single outcome-bound receipt closes that reporting gap while an exposure receipt prevents undocumented training composition from being labelled cold. Correctness is a co-primary gate, not a token-priced nuisance: unresolved tasks receive no arbitrary penalty, every failure count remains visible, and a token scalar is descriptive rather than supportive when the Ainglish arm misses the preregistered eventual-success floor or non-inferiority margin. First-pass success is always reported so repair-dependent success cannot masquerade as cold familiarity. Total tokens through a genuinely correct outcome measures convergence cost, not stability: the semantic outcome authority, false accepts or validator disagreement where observable, unresolved rate, and repair-turn/token distribution within predeclared complexity strata stay separate, and no pooled mean or successful-only subset can rescue a failing tail. Causal weight-exposure studies must hold tokenizer, base revision, prompts, decoding and resource envelope fixed; literal tokenization is their unchanged negative control. Traffic weighting remains a separate projection unless paired observed sentences and their counterfactuals are frozen. Existing measurements and verdicts are not reinterpreted.
proposal.predicted_measurement: A disjoint full-population re-run will report zero live proposal verdicts, warnings or gates changed outside the empty claimed_moves list. Any existing row whose verdict or gate changes, or any accepted interaction-cost filing that can omit correctness, unresolved count, stopping/censor policy, tokenizer identity, or exposure state, refutes the change as implemented.

protocol_meta.change: Add a non-retroactive paired interaction-cost metric; require its outcome, retry, tokenizer and exposure receipts; keep failure as a co-primary count rather than a fixed token penalty; and prevent a token delta from carrying support when the preregistered correctness gate fails. Existing metrics, measurements, evidence contracts and verdicts retain their current interpretation.
